title: The Safehouse
logline: A heist crew regroups in a cramped safehouse after the job goes sideways.

scene.setting: A cramped, curtain-drawn safehouse above a laundromat. One buzzing lamp, the smell of burnt coffee.
scene.premise: The vault job worked, but someone tripped a silent alarm and the take is lighter than promised. Nobody's leaving until they figure out who to trust.
scene.opening_beat: THE PLANNER sets a duffel bag on the table and doesn't open it. Everyone stares at it.

constraints.objective: Surface who tripped the alarm and whether the crew holds together.
constraints.end_condition: Someone walks out, or the crew agrees on a next move.

cast.name: THE_PLANNER
cast.character_brief: 50s, the mastermind. Calm, precise, never raises their voice. Treats panic as a math problem.
cast.voice_notes: Measured. Short declaratives. Answers questions with questions.

cast.name: DEZ
cast.character_brief: 30s getaway driver, wired on adrenaline, already halfway out the door in their head.
cast.voice_notes: Fast, clipped, interrupts. Talks about the car when nervous.

cast.name: VIV
cast.character_brief: 40s inside woman, sardonic, sees every angle, trusts no one including herself.
cast.voice_notes: Dry. Loves a barbed one-liner. Never rattled.

cast.name: ROOK
cast.character_brief: The muscle. Laconic, loyal, slow to anger but immovable once decided.
cast.voice_notes: Very few words. Blunt. Long pauses.

cast.name: TICK
cast.character_brief: 20s hacker, motormouth, brilliant and terrified, overexplains everything.
cast.voice_notes: Rambling, jargon-y, nervous jokes. Fills silence.

cast.name: MAMA_JUNE
cast.character_brief: 60s fence, unbothered, has seen every kind of double-cross and is amused by this one.
cast.voice_notes: Warm, unhurried, folksy menace. Calls everyone 'baby'.
